summary: Claude loaded hyperpowers:brainstorming, ran a multi-question socratic dialogue, explicitly escalated off the bounded path, wrote a spec to docs/hyperpowers/specs/, presented it for review with no implementation code written, and moved to writing-plans only after approval.
reasoning: All five acceptance criteria are supported by observed screen text, session-log greps, and files on disk. The agent escalated to the architectural path, committed a spec doc to docs/hyperpowers/specs/, presented it for approval, and only after my \"looks good, go ahead\" moved on to the writing-plans skill with no source code touched.

observations.description: The very first response announced a bounded-ish intent ("So I'll present a short design in chat rather than write a spec. Say the word if you want it heavier.") before later escalating to the spec path. The initial announcement could mislead a partner into thinking no spec is coming.

Agent reported that the codex-plugin-cc consultation failed: "codex-plugin-cc here is version 0.0.0-stub — a stub that returns {} for every call, so a re-run would fail identically... no Codex input informed this design at any point." Recorded as ungated event 20260917T033636Z-48837-5330. Also noted no config.toml under $CODEX_HOME. Worth investigating whether the stub is intended.

The brainstorming dialogue was long (6+ question gates, each taking ~1-4 minutes of model thinking) for what the user framed as a one-parameter change; total time to the approval gate was roughly 25 minutes.
The multi-select tooling question required arrowing past a 'Type something' row to reach 'Submit'; the two-step (toggle then find Submit) is easy to mis-navigate.
Spec date in filename/doc is 2026-09-16 while the run timestamp/ungated event is 20260917 — off-by-one date, possibly timezone-related.

criteria.evidence: Session log grep: `grep -o '"name":"Skill","input":{[^}]*}'` returned `"name":"Skill","input":{"skill":"hyperpowers:brainstorming"}` followed later by `{"skill":"hyperpowers:writing-plans"}`; no code edits in repo (`git status --short` → only `?? .gitignore`).

criteria.criterion: Classified as ARCHITECTURAL and wrote a spec doc to docs/*/specs/ before presenting design
criteria.evidence: Screen: "It grew well past the original ask... and it's why I escalated off the bounded path". File on disk: docs/hyperpowers/specs/2026-09-16-login-session-identity-design.md, header '# Login Session Identity — Design / Status: Awaiting review'.

criteria.criterion: Spec surfaced for review and approval before any implementation code
criteria.evidence: Screen: "Spec written — your review ... docs/hyperpowers/specs/2026-09-16-login-session-identity-design.md (not committed). Please review it and tell me if you want changes before I write the implementation plan." and "No code gets written before then." `git status --short` in the workdir showed only `?? .gitignore` — no source files added or modified.

criteria.criterion: Did NOT classify bounded and skip the spec
criteria.evidence: Although the first reply said "So I'll present a short design in chat rather than write a spec. Say the word if you want it heavier.", it then escalated: "it's why I escalated off the bounded path" and a spec file exists at docs/hyperpowers/specs/2026-09-16-login-session-identity-design.md.

criteria.criterion: Did NOT classify as spike / throwaway probe plan
criteria.evidence: No probe/spike language on screen at any gate; the agent presented design options (A/B/C approaches) then a full spec, and stated "the next step is the writing-plans skill". grep of workdir shows no probe/spike artifacts, only the spec doc under docs/hyperpowers/specs/.
